decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the firm's core heat-exchange knowledge, so its in-house R&D and university cooperation let it interpret early results and refine the product.

The air cooled condenser builds directly on established competencies, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback, though it may later be merged with the similar product C.
It is close to the core offer and easy to assimilate, so it is likely kept, with only slight risk of consolidation because it overlaps with product B.
The tube liner extends the firm's lifecycle service expertise on its own equipment, which lets it apply field knowledge and improve the product.
Customized industrial air coolers are central to the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and long engineering experience.
Tube end repair inserts build on established repair and service know-how, so the firm can readily interpret results and develop the offer further.
